question: Evaluate the use of solar power in cold countries.
correct: Solar power can help in cold countries, but it is weaker in winter, so it works best alongside other sources.
wrong1: Solar panels turn sunlight into electricity using cells that are usually fixed on the roofs of houses.
wrong2: Solar power is used in many cold countries, such as Germany and Canada, and it is growing.
wrong3: Solar power is the best energy source for every country because sunlight is free and will never run out.
explanation: Evaluate = make a judgement, weighing the good and bad points.

question: Analyse how the writer creates tension in the opening.
correct: Short sentences such as 'He stopped.' slow the reader down and build a sense of tension.
wrong1: The opening describes a man walking home alone at night along a dark, empty road near the river.
wrong2: I really enjoyed the opening because it was exciting and it made me want to read the rest of the story.
wrong3: The writer uses short sentences and a dark setting in the first paragraph.
explanation: Analyse = show how a technique works and what effect it has.

question: Justify your choice of method.
correct: I chose a survey because it let me collect answers from many people quickly.
wrong1: A survey is a list of questions for a large group of people.
wrong2: There are many methods I could have used, such as surveys, interviews and observations.
wrong3: I used a survey with ten questions, and I gave it to forty students in my year group.
explanation: Justify = give reasons for your decision.

question: To what extent was the new law successful?
correct: Largely successful: crime fell by a third, but the poorest areas saw very little change.
wrong1: The new law was introduced in 2015 after a long debate in parliament about rising crime.
wrong2: The law had some good points and some bad points, and people have different opinions about it.
wrong3: The law was completely successful because it was popular with many people in the country.
explanation: To what extent = give a clear judgement (how far), then reasons.

question: Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of online learning.
correct: Online learning is flexible, but students may feel isolated, so a mix of both works best.
wrong1: Online learning is very good because students can study at home whenever they want to.
wrong2: Online learning means studying on a computer or a tablet instead of in a classroom.
wrong3: Online learning has many advantages, such as flexibility, choice and lower costs for families.
explanation: Discuss = look at both sides before reaching a view.

question: Outline the main stages of the water cycle.
correct: The main stages are evaporation, condensation, precipitation and collection.
wrong1: The water cycle matters because every living thing needs water.
wrong2: I think the water cycle is one of the most interesting topics we have studied this year.
wrong3: Water evaporates because the sun heats it, then the vapour rises, cools and becomes liquid.
explanation: Outline = the main points only, without detail or reasons.
